dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: Whether conclusions and proposed actions are technically correct for the available evidence.

levels.2: Partially correct but contains important errors.

examples: Correctly distinguishes current repository state from intended future work.

dimensions.name: Task Adherence
dimensions.description: Whether the workflow follows the requested scope, role boundaries, and acceptance criteria.

levels.2: Meets some requirements but misses important constraints.
levels.3: Meets the requested task and constraints.
levels.4: Fully satisfies the task with disciplined scope.

examples: Reviewer evaluates work without modifying implementation files.

dimensions.name: Groundedness
dimensions.description: Whether important claims are tied to repository, retrieval, test, or audit evidence.

levels.2: Some evidence but important claims are unsupported.
levels.3: Key claims are supported by evidence.
levels.4: Claims are consistently traceable to strong evidence.

examples: Retrieved lessons include citations and repository claims reference current evidence.

dimensions.name: Review Quality
dimensions.description: Whether review identifies meaningful risks and routes unresolved issues appropriately.

levels.2: Finds surface issues but misses major risks.
levels.3: Finds important issues and recommends an appropriate route.

examples: A blocking pagination issue produces REVISE instead of silently advancing.
